Choosing the right caliper for your workshop

By J. Reyes, published 1 March 2026.

A precision caliper is one of the most useful tools in any workshop. This guide covers what to look for: measuring range, resolution, and build quality, so you can pick the right one for the job at hand.

Measuring range

Most hobbyist work is comfortably covered by a 150 millimetre range, while larger components call for a longer jaw.
